title: HUNGRY EYES
lyrics_synced:
[00:11.45] A canvas-covered cabin
[00:16.02] in a crowded labor camp
[00:20.88] stand out in this memory I revive,
[00:29.99] 'cause my daddy raised the fam'ly there
[00:35.00] with two hard-workin' hands
[00:39.71] and tried to feed my mama's hungry eyes.
[00:49.12] He dreamed of somethin' better,
[00:53.54] and my mama's faith was strong,
[00:58.23] and us, kids, were just too young to realize
[01:07.65] that another class of people
[01:12.36] put us somewhere just below;
[01:17.05] one more reason for my mama's hungry eyes.
[01:25.88] Mama never had the luxuries she wanted,
[01:35.88] but it wasn't 'cause my daddy didn't try.
[01:45.57] She only wanted things she really needed;
[01:54.68] one more reason for my mama's hungry eyes.
[02:04.11] I remember daddy prayin'
[02:08.82] for a better way of life
[02:13.66] but I don't recall a change of any size,
[02:22.93] just a little loss of courage
[02:27.64] as their age began to show,
[02:32.33] and more sadness in my mama's hungry eyes.
[02:41.18] Mama never had the luxuries she wanted,
[02:51.18] but it wasn't 'cause my daddy didn't try.
[03:00.86] She only wanted things she really needed;
[03:09.97] one more reason for my mama's hungry eyes.
[03:19.11] Oh, I still recall my mama's hungry eyes.
